runtime_portability_observation.comparison: independent authored observation generator only; no decoder or pYIN execution

limitations: Corpus checks are original ZIP/source provenance, historical exact identity, public scalar/score arithmetic, gain/loss set consistency and recorded private-audit claim consistency; private corpus arrays and notes were not retained in this public artifact.

The runner private audit reports direct rescoring of its saved corpus notes; this offline audit does not independently reexecute that unavailable private-file check or verify corpus reference matching identities.

All public synthetic event lists and authored truth are independently reconstructed/validated and directly rescored with mir_eval. This verifies scoring, not that the saved paths are Viterbi-optimal or generated by the declared decoder.

Synthetic ambiguous controls are excluded from the 227-case accuracy denominator; separately calculated authored/alternative scores are diagnostic, and silence controls use false-positive counts without invented F1.
The analytic 2x2 emission table is independently recalculated; it does not constitute decoded factorial performance or establish interactions on the corpus.
A fixed seed paired percentile interval describes the same forty reused development recordings. There is no held-out generalization, source-Tony equivalence, product quality or human-edit claim.
Saved report declarations and byte identities cannot independently establish historical access order or actual execution identity. No pYIN, HMM, Viterbi or acoustic inference was rerun.
